content:
A small reminder of why matrimonial litigation is often won or lost on the details.
 
A Section 12 PWDV complaint was filed in a particular court by claiming temporary residence within its jurisdiction.
 
We challenged the jurisdiction itself.
 
After examining the surrounding circumstances and the material on record, the Court found that the claimed temporary residence was not established and held that it lacked territorial jurisdiction.
 
Complaint rejected.
 
You don't always have to fight the entire case. Sometimes, you just have to find the right door to close.
